responsibility: Implements builtin Rust #[derive(Debug)] expansion in the Rust front end. This file defines the concrete derive visitor that synthesizes a core::fmt::Debug trait impl as AST items, currently generating a stub fmt(&self, _fmt: &mut core::fmt::Formatter) -> core::fmt::Result method that returns Result::Ok(()) rather than formatting fields, wiring generic bounds through setup_impl_generics for structs, tuple structs, and enums, and rejecting unions with a diagnostic during expansion.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the Debug derive expander: it defines DeriveDebug methods that actually synthesize the core::fmt::Debug impl and stub fmt body, whereas rust-derive-debug.h only declares the DeriveDebug class interface and helper signatures.
